sentences.text: Heard on I.A. No.10017/2025, which is second application filed under Section 430(1) of BNS, 2023 [389(1) of Cr.P.C.] for suspension of jail sentence and grant of bail moved on behalf of the appellant No.1- Praveen.

2. Learned Trial Court has convicted the present appellant under Sections 376(3) of IPC, 3/4,
5(J-II)/6 of Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012 and sentenced to undergo 20 years, 07 years and 10 years R.I with fine of Rs.2,000/-, Rs.1,000/- and Rs.1,000/- respectively with default stipulations vide its judgement of conviction and order of sentence dated 23.08.2022 passed by the Special Judge (POCSO) Act, Ratlam, District Ratlam in S.C. No.09/2020.
3.

sentences.text: The appellant seems to be first cousin of the prosecutrix and he made her pregnant despite knowing their relationship.
